g.text: Radius Retail Operating System — End-to-End Architecture
3-Tier Go Monolith • Gorilla WebSockets • Expo SDK 54 • PostgreSQL 16 (40 Migrations) • Redis
TIER 1: CLIENT FRONTEND — REACT NATIVE & EXPO SDK 54
• Item Pick Reason Log & Status Guard
• Releases locked bopis_qty back to sellable

• Active JWT session registry & instant remote kill blacklist
